title: Data refinement is not DEV, TEST and PROD
summary: A processing layer and a deployment environment are independent coordinates.

claims.text: Medallion architecture separates raw, refined and consumption-ready data responsibilities.

levels.overview: Follow a fictional event from received data to a useful report.
levels.architecture: Place refinement responsibilities on one axis and environments on another.
levels.detail: Inspect validation, rejects, schema and consumption contracts. Do not invent nine physical stores.

example.input: One synthetic reading has a value; another is missing its required timestamp.
steps: Explain the accepted output and rejected record.
example.output: An explicit accepted/rejected flow, repeated only in declared environments.
limits: No workload or tenant execution is implied.

alternatives.label: Direct pipeline
alternatives.whenToConsider: Consider when fewer stages satisfy the stated contract.

alternatives.label: Layered pipeline
alternatives.whenToConsider: Consider when distinct refinement responsibilities justify extra handoffs.

interview.question: Does a bronze/silver/gold design tell you where DEV, TEST and PROD are?
answerHints: Explain materialization as an independent decision.
